adapter.requiredDimensions: The dimensions the claim states: product always, version, setting, purpose and timing when the claim names them, population when it states an age, conditions or exclusions, metric when it states a performance. A dimension the claim is silent on is not asserted (ANSWER-KEY.md, semantics 1).
adapter.dependencies: Every claim declares an authorization record and a study as required: the question is always whether the authorization and the evidence the regulator reviewed (or the published study) cover the use. Without the declaration the compiler lets only the authorization support a dimension when the claim states no number.
adapter.stalenessWindowNote: A hospital policy supplied to every arm, 3 years, an assumption and not a standard; a case may carry its own.
adapter.versionsNote: A study item in an FDA summary inherits the version strings written elsewhere in the same summary. The inference is recorded on the item.
adapter.purposeFromExtraction: Extracted purpose terms are mapped to taxonomy nodes (vocabulary.ts); the broadest node wins, then a fixed priority.
adapter.sourceHealth: All sources reported OK: the fault drills of FailureShift test the other states.
